token_usage_schema.description: Total tokens billed for the decision (input plus output).
token_usage_schema.title: Token Usage

guide_findings: Examples have 89 input + 1 output / token_usage 90, and 743 + 252 / token_usage 995.
usage.input_tokens aggregates internal passes across questions and includes image tokens.
Guide advertises $0.04 per million input tokens and zero output-token price.
Examples do not resolve the discrepancy with the retained historical wire receipt.
interpretation: The schema description calls token_usage an input-plus-output billed total, but the retained wire counters contradict exact equality. The relationship among wire counters is not established; the proposal checks them independently, without changing the provisional input-cost basis.
